name: waifu-slayer
description: WAIFU-SLAYER by BOTNEX — Telegram Voice Chat Music Bot with queue management, AutoPlay and playback controls.

MONGO_DB_URI.description: Get a mongodb url from https://cloud.mongodb.com.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id of user whom you would like to add as OWNER.

STRING_SESSION.description: A Pyrogram v2 string session for the assistant account used by WAIFU-SLAYER.

LOGGER_ID.description: Your private Telegram logger group ID. Add the bot and assistant account and grant permission to send messages.

ERROR_LOGGER_ID.description: Telegram group ID where uncaught bot errors and tracebacks are reported.

CLONE_START_CONCURRENCY.description: How many saved clone bots can start in parallel after deploy/restart.

CLONE_START_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds allowed for one clone to start.

ASSISTANT_START_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum seconds allowed for one clone assistant to start.
